events.text: Confirmed the count-dependent gap is face-attribute drift: Door Wall 2 has a grey Door Frame and dark Door Leaf, while each preview recuts base geometry but replaceActiveEditMesh carries colors positionally from the previous preview. Changing 1→2→3 cuts changes face order/count, so the leaf's dark color temporarily lands on a frame face. The fix will inherit RGBA through CutResult.src_face from the captured base on every plane.

Implemented source-face RGBA inheritance across every loop-cut preview plane. The native two-plane regression keeps the unscoped sibling at its original two triangles and grey color; zig build test-mesh-edit and the full ReleaseFast editor ship both pass. Commit dd888ea60.

resolution: Fixed the 1→2→3 cut-count flicker by capturing true base face colors when the loop-cut session opens and inheriting RGBA through each plane's source-face map. Preview face order can now change without transferring the dark Door Leaf color onto the grey Door Frame; the same protection also covers edge loop cuts. Added a repeated masked-cut Zig regression and verified the full ReleaseFast editor build.
